verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships an official, well-documented CLI (brew/docker install, extensive flags like --include-detectors, --fail, --json) that was independently verified to run headlessly and produce structured JSON output without any account/API key, making it scriptable for agentic/automated workflows. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of AI-agent-specific integration patterns (e.g., MCP server, agent SDK) or independent long-term reliability benchmarks beyond the single hands-on probe.
